objective: Build secure local equivalents with Asolaria-controlled pipelines.

capabilities.title: Connector and tool orchestration
controls: Default-deny tool execution with explicit allowlist.
Run tool actions through risk scoring and approval gates.
Log tool payload summaries without leaking secrets.

capabilities.title: Messaging and collaboration integrations
controls: Enforce workspace/domain allowlists before any send action.
Separate read-only review from posting capabilities.
Block mass-send operations without explicit approval.

capabilities.title: Live transcription pipeline
controls: Keep raw audio local by default; require opt-in for cloud ASR.
Use append-only transcript audit logs with retention limits.
tests: Mic-only and loopback transcription accuracy regression test
Transcript drop-resilience test under queue pressure

capabilities.title: OAuth and identity workflows
controls: Never persist refresh/access tokens in plaintext artifacts.
Mask account identifiers in reports by default.

capabilities.title: Phone bridge and device control
controls: Require explicit device allowlist and serial pinning.
Block privileged shell paths unless owner-approved.
Store captures in local evidence folders with checksum metadata.
